guidanceReview.rationale: Hub handoffs retain Stop fences and accept optional private Edge proof. Readback notices, structured results, write identity, hook crash recovery, and byte budgets remain intact. OpenCode receipts may add node IDs. Existing Frame anchors continue to work across versions; additional visual region types require extension 1.1.1. Expired asset reclamation honors the existing TTL, and imports retain admission checks. Cached packages retain the existing bundle fingerprint and full verification before launch. Legacy reads, task recovery instructions, and extension, control and hook protocols remain compatible with epoch 1.
